in_hindi.long_meaning: जेहाँ पहुँचती है वह भ्रमरा (Jehā̃m pahunchatī hai vah bhramārā)

in_marathi.name: Bhramara
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhramara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhramara is the name of the goddess of bees. She is also known as the 'Queen of the Forest'. This name signifies the grace and beauty of nature.

in_bengali.name: Bhramara

in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhramara একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bhramara is the name of the goddess of bees. She is also known as the 'Queen of the Forest'. This name signifies the grace and beauty of nature.
